csv_project_name: Consultant for CBMPO Center Road Corridor Study
csv_scope_of_work: Bartow County ( County ) and the City of Cartersville ( City ) are soliciting proposals from qualified firm(s) or organization(s) to provide professional planning and transportation consultation services related to the redesign of Center Road Corridor. Center Road is a busy, curvilinear two-lane roadway that extends approximately three miles from U.S. highway 41/SR 3 eastward to Spur 20, crossing multiple times between the incorporated limits of Cartersville and the unincorporated areas of Bartow County. The study area includes Center Road from US 41 to Spur 20, including associated intersections and roadway segments impacted by existing, approved, and anticipated residential development. The purpose of this study is to evaluate current roadway conditions, traffic operations, safety concerns, land use patterns, and projected growth within the corridor. This effort will assist the County and City in proactively identifying transportation improvements, roadway enhancements, access management strategies, and multimodal considerations necessary to support appropriate and balanced residential growth in the area. The selected consultant will conduct a study to develop research-based, data-driven recommendations. The objective is to establish conceptual corridor layouts and improvement strategies that address both existing and future development demands. This study is not intended to produce final engineering design plans but will provide strategic guidance and planning-level alternatives to help guide future infrastructure investments and development. This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) seeks to identify a firm for the project/contract listed in Exhibit A. Firms that respond to this RFQ are invited to offer proposals and/or possibly present and/or interview for these services. All respondents to this RFQ are subject to instructions communicated in this document and are cautioned to completely review the entire RFQ and follow instructions carefully. Bartow County reserves the right to reject any or all Statements of Qualifications or Consultant Plan Proposals, and to waive technicalities and informalities at the discretion of Bartow County.

- Scope focuses on transportation planning, traffic operations, safety, land use, and growth management.
